paragraphs: Starbucks Corporation is an American multinational chain of coffeehouses and roastery reserves headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It was founded in 1971 by Jerry Baldwin, Zev Siegl, and Gordon Bowker at Seattle's Pike Place Market initially as a coffee bean wholesaler. Starbucks was converted into a coffee shop serving espresso-based drinks under the ownership of Howard Schultz, who was chief executive officer from 1986 to 2000 and led the aggressive expansion of the franchise across the West Coast of the United States.

As of November 2022, the company had 35,711 stores in 80 countries, 15,873 of which were located in the United States. Of Starbucks' U.S.-based stores, over 8,900 are company-operated, while the remainder are licensed. It is the world's largest coffeehouse chain. The company is ranked 120th on the Fortune 500 and 303rd on the Forbes Global 2000, as of 2022.

The rise of the second wave of coffee culture is generally attributed to Starbucks, which introduced a wider variety of coffee experiences. Starbucks serves hot and cold drinks, whole-bean coffee, micro-ground instant coffee, espresso, caffe latte, full and loose-leaf teas, juices, Frappuccino beverages, pastries, and snacks. Some offerings are seasonal or specific to the locality of the store. Depending on the country, most locations provide free Wi-Fi Internet access. The company has been subject to multiple controversies related to its business practices. Conversely, its franchise has commanded substantial brand loyalty, market share, and company value.

people.name: Brian Niccol
people.title: chairman and chief executive officer
people.bio: Joined Starbucks as chairman and chief executive officer in September 2024. Previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Chipotle from 2018 to 2024 and Taco Bell from 2015 to 2018.
people.quote: Brian Niccol joined Starbucks as chairman and chief executive officer in September 2024.

people.name: Cathy R. Smith
people.title: executive vice president, chief financial officer
people.bio: Joined Starbucks as executive vice president, chief financial officer in March 2025. Previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of Nordstrom and held chief financial officer roles at Bright Health Group and Target.
people.quote: Cathy R. Smith joined Starbucks in March 2025 as executive vice president, chief financial officer,

people.name: Mike Grams
people.title: executive vice president, chief operating officer
people.bio: Joined Starbucks in February 2025 as executive vice president, North America chief coffeehouse officer and became chief operating officer in June 2025. Previously spent nearly thirty years at Taco Bell, including as President and Chief Operating Officer from 2020 to December 2024.
people.quote: Mike Grams joined Starbucks in February 2025 as executive vice president, North America chief coffeehouse officer,

people.name: Brady Brewer
people.title: chief executive officer, Starbucks International
people.bio: Joined Starbucks in 2001 and has served as chief executive officer, Starbucks International since April 2024. Previously served as Starbucks executive vice president and chief marketing officer from February 2020 through March 2024.
people.quote: Brady Brewer joined Starbucks in 2001 and has served as chief executive officer, Starbucks International since April 2024,

people.name: Sara Kelly
people.title: executive vice president, chief partner officer
people.bio: Joined Starbucks in 2001 and has served as executive vice president and chief partner officer since 2022. Previously served as senior vice president, Talent & Partner Experience from 2021 to 2022 and vice president, Partner Resources from 2014 to 2021.
people.quote: Sara Kelly joined Starbucks in 2001 and has served as executive vice president and chief partner officer since 2022,

people.name: Pilar Ramos
people.title: executive vice president, chief legal officer
people.bio: Joined Starbucks in November 2025 as executive vice president and chief legal officer, leading the Law & Corporate Affairs organization. Previously served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary of TelevisaUnivision from August 2021 to October 2025 and held various roles at Mastercard from 2003 to 2021.
people.quote: Pilar Ramos joined Starbucks in November 2025 as executive vice president and chief legal officer.

people.name: Ritch Allison
people.title: Director
people.bio: Richard E. Allison, Jr. served as Chief Executive Officer and a director of Domino's from 2018 to 2022, then as a senior advisor until retiring later in 2022. Previously, he was President of Domino's International and a partner at Bain.
people.quote: RICHARD E. ALLISON, JR., served as Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the board of directors of Domino's Pizza, Inc.

people.name: Andy Campion
people.title: Director
people.bio: Andrew Campion serves as Executive Chairman and CEO of Unrivaled Sports. He held executive leadership roles at Nike from 2007 to April 2024 and previously spent over 11 years at The Walt Disney Company.
people.quote: ANDREW CAMPION currently serves as Executive Chairman and CEO of Unrivaled Sports

people.name: Beth Ford
people.title: Director
people.bio: Beth Ford serves as President and Chief Executive Officer of Land O'Lakes. She joined Land O'Lakes in 2011 and held roles across its businesses before becoming chief executive officer in 2018.
people.quote: BETH FORD serves as President and Chief Executive Officer of Land O'Lakes, Inc.

people.name: J rgen Vig Knudstorp
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Mr. Knudstorp is Deputy Chair of the LEGO Foundation and Chair of BrainPOP Education. He served as President and Chief Executive Officer of the LEGO Group from 2004 to 2016 and has been Starbucks lead independent director since March 2025.
people.quote: J RGEN VIG KNUDSTORP is currently Deputy Chair of the LEGO Foundation and Chair of BrainPOP Education

people.name: Marissa Mayer
people.title: Director
people.bio: Marissa Mayer is Chief Executive Officer of Dazzle AI. She previously served as CEO of Sunshine AI from 2018 to 2025 and as CEO, President, and a director of Yahoo! from 2012 to 2017.
people.quote: MARISSA MAYER is Chief Executive Officer of Dazzle AI, Inc., a technology startup company based in Palo Alto, California

people.name: Neal Mohan
people.title: Director
people.bio: Neal Mohan has served as Chief Executive Officer of YouTube since February 2023, following service as its Chief Product Officer from 2015. Previously, he held senior roles at Google and DoubleClick.
people.quote: NEAL MOHAN has served as Chief Executive Officer of YouTube

people.name: Dambisa Moyo
people.title: Director
people.bio: Dambisa Moyo has served as co-principal of Versaca Investments since co-founding it in 2021. She is a global economist and commentator analyzing the macroeconomy and international affairs.
people.quote: DAMBISA MOYO has served as co-principal of Versaca Investments, a family office focused on growth investing globally

people.name: Brian Niccol
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Brian Niccol has served as chairman of the board and chief executive officer of Starbucks since September 2024.
people.quote: Mr. Niccol has served as chairman of the board and chief executive officer of Starbucks since September 2024.

people.name: Daniel Servitje
people.title: Director
people.bio: Daniel Servitje served as Executive Chair of the Board of Grupo Bimbo. He serves on Starbucks Audit and Compliance Committee.
people.quote: Grupo Bimbo, where Mr. Servitje served as Executive Chair of the Board.

people.name: Mike Sievert
people.title: Director
people.bio: Mike Sievert formerly served as an executive officer of T-Mobile and currently serves as its vice chairman and a board member.
people.quote: Mr. Sievert formerly served as an executive officer and currently serves as vice chairman and a board member.

people.name: Wei Zhang
people.title: Director
people.bio: Wei Zhang was Senior Advisor and President of Alibaba Pictures Group, leading global operations from its formation in 2014 until her retirement in 2021. She previously held leadership roles at Alibaba Group, Star China, and CNBC China.
people.quote: WEI ZHANG was Senior Advisor and President of Alibaba Pictures Group, leading global operations from its formation in 2014 through her retirement in 2021.
